subject: System Design
title: Load Balancers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Load Balancers.

hook.text: One server handles 1,000 requests per second. You need to handle 50,000. What do you do?

buildup.text: A load balancer sits in front of multiple servers and distributes incoming requests across them.

discovery.text: Round-robin, least connections, and weighted algorithms decide which server gets each request.

twist.text: Load balancers also detect unhealthy servers and stop sending traffic to them automatically.

climax.text: Without load balancers, scaling horizontally would be impossible. They're the traffic cops of the internet.

punchline.text: Split the traffic, multiply the capacity.

quiz.question: What does a load balancer do?
